target: acceptance 1 — doctor.sh must actually surface an over-cap file, not merely mention the tool. The prior version passed against a comment admitting learnings.sh was not called.
cmd: cp "$FIXTURES/learnings/over.md" LEARNINGS.md; o=$(bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/doctor.sh" 2>&1 || true); over=$(printf "%s" "$o" | grep -ci "over the cap"); cnt=$(printf "%s" "$o" | grep -cE "40[0-9] lines"); cp "$FIXTURES/learnings/under.md" LEARNINGS.md; o2=$(bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/doctor.sh" 2>&1 || true); clean=$(printf "%s" "$o2" | grep -ci "clean"); printf '{"warnsOver":%s,"showsCount":%s,"saysCleanWhenUnder":%s}' "$over" "$cnt" "$clean"
